composition_variation: Create a cozy painterly anime illustration of adult Kakashi Hatake reading a plain green gardening paperback in a quiet bookshop. Keep his silver gravity-defying hair, lower-face cloth mask, forehead protector, and relaxed visible eye recognizable. He wears a fully covering navy jacket and comfortable trousers. He leans gently against a narrow windowsill, holding the book at chest height with simple natural fingers. Use rainy blue window reflections, warm oak shelves, amber reading light, and generous soft upper-window haze. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
